title: The Cycle Class Map, the Reverse Arrow, and a Classical Constructor on Three Fourfolds: Lean 4 Formalization and Hodge Ledger

description: Master 42-module Lean 4 formalization and two companion papers (CYCLE_CLASS_AND_CONSTRUCTOR.pdf and frohman-hodge-source-note.pdf) analyzing the cycle class map cl_X : Z^2(X)_Q → Hdg^2(X,Q), classical cycle constructors across smooth cubic, Fermat quintic, and three-chain sextic fourfolds, Griffiths Jacobian residue rings, and the exact boundary between certified algebraic spans and the open reverse arrow.
